scripts.dev: npm run build -w @impartation/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client "npm run dev -w @impartation/shared" "npm run dev -w @impartation/backend" "npm run dev -w @impartation/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @impartation/shared && npm run build -w @impartation/backend && npm run build -w @impartation/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @impartation/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run test:e2e
